info.name: Selaras Platform (Go)
info.description: The whole edge.v1 flow over the Connect protocol, ready to "Run" with no setup: the local stack must be running (task up:full), then run this collection in order. Tokens, slugs, and ids are captured between requests; the email is unique per run. The source of truth is api/proto/edge/v1.

item.name: 1 · Auth
item.description: Sign up, sign in, see yourself. The token from Login is kept in {{bearerToken}} and used by every later request.

request.description: The email is made unique per run by the pre-request script.
Signing in revokes every earlier session (D1); the token from Register stops working after this.
Required before a risk assessment: age, sex, and country select the SCORE2 table.
SCORE2 is computed synchronously; the LLM report is requested separately.
Queues the LLM job and returns at once; the report appears on GetAssessment (or WatchAssessment) a few seconds later with the fake provider.
A read-model materialised from events; the short pause lets the projection catch up.
Sourced from the assessment above (D3: one program per assessment). Coaching learns of the assessment through an event, hence the pause.
The status says whether the report is PENDING or READY. Requesting it locks the program (D5), so the thread is deleted first.
An unknown enum name is refused, not read as "no craving" (the strict codec, ADR-027).
The link goes to Mailpit: http://127.0.0.1:18025. Confirming needs the token from that email, so it is not part of the automatic run.
Revocation through the generation counter (ADR-020) takes effect at once.
The deletion saga across units (ADR-011); the status says IN_PROGRESS because the other units delete their data through events.
